newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to reopen dialogue with Cuba shortly.
newsitem.headline: Spain to reopen dialogue with Cuba shortly.

text.p: Spain will reopen contacts with Cuba in the next few days in an effort to ease a diplomatic crisis over Havana's rejection of a new Spanish ambassador, Foreign Minister Abel Matutes said on Wednesday.
"There will be a dialogue on our part in the next few days. We are waiting for the tension...to ease in order to restart these contacts," Matutes told reporters.
He declined to provide further details on the contacts.

There have been no talks between the two countries since last Tuesday when Cuba, angered by Spain's insistence on democratic reforms, withdrew its earlier approval for Spanish ambassador Jose Coderch and accused Spain of interference.

"It remains to be seen if we can get past the debate and revive the dialogue, helping the Cuban government with positive measures," Matutes said earlier on Wednesday in remarks to parliament's foreign affairs committee.
